title: Skip non-positive quantities vs refunds as negative lines

agents.task: Make subtotal in src/checkout.ts ignore lines whose qty is 0 or negative (they count as removed from the cart). Add tests in test/checkout.test.ts. You own src/checkout.ts and test/checkout.test.ts.

Support refunds in orderSummary (src/order.ts): an item with a negative qty is a refund. Its receipt line is `Refund ${sku} x${-qty} -${formatPrice(priceCents * -qty)}` and it reduces subtotal and total (a $10 item plus a $3 refund totals $7). Add tests in test/refunds.test.ts. You own src/order.ts and test/refunds.test.ts.

notes: Semantic conflict on the meaning of qty < 0. Correct merge: subtotal skips only qty === 0 and keeps negative lines as refunds.
